quote: I would say primary, you know, just wanting to be cleaner and greener.
stewart_read: Customer gave a fuller-than-average interest answer including rising energy costs, but rep's reply ('electric bills have been going crazy lately') didn't tie this back to the bill or the coming appointment.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the reply sufficient rapport and chosen not to over-linger, consistent with setter-scope discipline.
coaching_implication: Reflect the customer's own words back later when setting the appointment: 'we'll show you how going solar addresses that rising-cost trend you mentioned.'

quote: I'm not I'm not seeing it at the moment, so it's not something I can probably produce right this morning.
stewart_read: Customer couldn't produce the bill and was heading out the door; rep pivoted to text/photo, a reasonable alternative path given the time crunch.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read: rep could have tried a verbal read-back of usage numbers before conceding to a text-later path, per elderly_low_tech_protocol logic (even though customer isn't elderly, the same pivot applies to any time-crunched customer).
coaching_implication: Try one verbal-readback attempt before defaulting to 'send me a text' when the customer is time-pressured but still on the phone.

quote: maybe I'll if I don't hear from you, maybe I'll just follow-up on Friday. Would that work?
stewart_read: No specific time was locked, and the offer was hedged with a conditional ('if I don't hear from you'), leaving the follow-up structurally fragile.
coaching_implication: Lock a specific time slot on Friday even for a callback — 'Friday at 2pm, does that work?' — rather than leaving the day open-ended.

quote: I'm sorry. I was a little distracted. Your name one more time?
stewart_read: Customer's admission of distraction and forgetting the rep's name at the very end is a signal the button-up didn't land or wasn't retained.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep intent was fine (kept call brief per customer's own busy morning) but the close should have re-confirmed the plan once distraction surfaced.
coaching_implication: When a customer says they're distracted right before hanging up, re-state the callback day/time once more slowly to lock retention.

quote: Is there anybody else on the title of the home with you? I believe it's probably my wife as well.
stewart_read: Wife was identified as a probable co-owner but never confirmed for the Friday follow-up or appointment.
alternative_hypothesis: This was only a tentative callback, not a full appointment yet, so spouse-inclusion may be premature — reactive read: rep should still have flagged it for the eventual appointment.
coaching_implication: Note the wife as co-owner now so the eventual booking call includes her from the start.
